name: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Karnataka)
short_description: Free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month for all residential households in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Gruha Jyothi provides zero-electricity bills up to 200 units of monthly domestic electricity consumption to all household consumers in Karnataka whose average consumption is within their eligible entitlement limit.
description_kannada: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಮನೆ ಬಳಕೆದಾರರಿಗೆ ತಿಂಗಳಿಗೆ 200 ಯೂನಿಟ್‌ಗಳವರೆಗೆ ಉಚಿತ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ ಯೋಜನೆ.

rules.name: Resident of Karnataka
rules.source_citation: Govt Order No. EN 22 PSR 2023, Energy Dept, Govt of Karnataka
rules.clarification_question_en: Are you living in a household in Karnataka?

benefits_summary: Zero electricity charge for domestic consumption up to 200 units/month.
required_documents: Electricity Account ID / Connection Consumer Number (from BESCOM/MESCOM/HESCOM/GESCOM/CESC)
application_process: Enter your electricity ESCOM name and Consumer Account ID.
Select whether applicant is Owner or Tenant and submit.
source_excerpt: The Gruha Jyothi scheme provides up to 200 units of free power to all domestic electricity consumers in the state of Karnataka.
